title: Upper-density estimate t·H^n(A) ≤ μ(W) (Simon Ch. 1, 3.3), every n ≥ 0
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^N, W ⊆ ℝ^N open, A ⊆ W an arbitrary set and t ∈ [0, ∞]. Suppose that for every x ∈ A, t ≤ limsup_{ρ↓0} μ(B_ρ(x))/(ω_n ρ^n), the limsup of densityRatio n μ x along 𝓝[>] 0. Then t · H^n(A) ≤ μ(W), where H^n = μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (W A : Set (Euclidean N)) (t : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen W → A ⊆ W → (∀ x ∈ A, t ≤ limsup (densityRatio n μ x) (𝓝[>] 0)) → t * μHE[n] A ≤ μ W
